posts.text: Gina Hinojosa is the Democratic nominee for Texas governor, setting up a showdown with incumbent Greg Abbott. The Latina state representative from Austin's 49th District, a Brownsville native and former civil rights lawyer, has been a champion for public education funding. She aims to become Texas's first Latina governor by challenging Abbott's policies on schools and vouchers. #ginahinojosa #texas #governor #xavierbecerra #abbott

I have lived a lifetime in just a few years. I’m a young mom, who was the first to go to and graduate from college in her low-income family. I became a teen mom as a freshman in college. This cancer journey came to a surprise. If you told me a few years ago that I would go through this, plus have another kid and meet a living president, I’d be shook, but definitely filled with happiness. 🙏🏽🩷 #cancersucks #firstgen #advocacy #latina #leukemia

Jaqueline Ramirez Juarez is a senior and honors student at Cedartown High School in Georgia. She’s a part of the National Honors Society, Key Club, and Skills USA. She was recently accepted to Georgia Highlands College and had plans of studying to become a nurse. She comes from a single-parent household and takes care of her younger siblings. Now, after being detained by ICE just a few weeks before graduation, her family has been left with financially hardship from all of the legal fees. #jaquel

In California, former Health Secretary Xavier Becerra is surging in the gubernatorial race after fellow Democrat Eric Swalwell suspended his campaign following SA allegations. Becerra has raised $400,000 in just days after Swalwell's exit and is rapidly  gaining support as Democrats consolidate behind him. California has not had a Latino governor since 1875, when Romualdo Pacheco served less than 10 months. #XavierBecerra #california #news #nessadiosdado #latino
